title: Platform Whitepaper
intro: A practical architecture guide for sovereign AI operations, orchestration, enterprise knowledge retrieval, and deployment models.

sections.title: Architecture
sections.copy: OmniNStack combines presentation, governance, orchestration, data, and infrastructure layers into one secure AI operating model.

sections.title: Governance
sections.copy: Policy-aware control, immutable logging, and identity-aware decisions support production-grade trust and compliance requirements.

sections.title: Agentic Workflows
sections.copy: Autonomous agents plan, route, and verify tasks across internal systems, models, and retrieval layers while preserving correctness and accountability.

sections.title: Deployment
sections.copy: The platform can be deployed across sovereign, on-premise, and hybrid environments with a hardware-agnostic foundation for secure AI operations.
